about: D19 (docs/language-packs.md §2.1): every grammar page has a contrast note for each SUPPORTED native (the languages of the UI locales) other than the page's own language, and one for each entry of `types` (a type note names no language). R1 (2026-10-11): a learner sees “From your languages” first (the note for their native — or, if it is not supported, for its branch, family or type — then one per C1/C2 language), then “Among the languages you are learning”, then, folded, “From other languages”: every other note, including those for the other languages of `languages` (the reference set of D18, chosen by the user 2026-10-09), which also serve inference by type and family.
